prompts.title: Two Lanes, One Forge
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original Ukraine Atlas collectible reveal-background candidate, a single full-bleed landscape 16:9 image, ideally 1536 x 864 pixels.
Primary request: A richly detailed modern pixel-art scene of a peaceful Ukrainian village forge at blue hour, with the warm working heart of a community revealed behind two distinct passages around its central workshop. This is original game story artwork, not a gameplay screenshot.
Scene and cultural grounding: A fictional Poltava-region craft courtyard inspired only by museum descriptions of Ukrainian working forges: modest red-clay plastered timber workshop, broad projecting reed gabled roof, open forge hearth, bellows, anvil mounted on a thick wood stump, simple iron hand tools on wall hooks, water barrel, wooden cart wheel being repaired. Invent the building and objects; do not reproduce a real museum photograph, maker's stamp or named craftsman's design.
Composition: Ground-level wide view from the courtyard, workshop as central large silhouette; two clearly visible open human-scale lanes pass on either side and rejoin beyond. Warm orange hearth seen inside, an artisan in plain linen work clothes attending a cart fitting, small workshop items worth discovering at full reveal; distant whitewashed homes and orchard become cool navy silhouettes. Clear spatial depth, asymmetry in small details, believable tools and hands. The lanes are visual storytelling only, no grids or path arrows.
Style: Premium contemporary detailed pixel art with crisp deliberate stepped edges, clustered pixels and restrained dithering, substantial silhouettes, not photorealism or a blurry oil painting. Dark navy and slate-blue shadows, warm amber/copper illumination and restrained cream highlights; warm inviting mood without combat. Keep the top sky and outer dark ground relatively calm so a later game overlay could be legible. Intricate materials and rewarding focal detail without luminous noise across every surface.
Constraints: One coherent standalone image, full rectangular landscape with no border, no lettering, no logos, no signatures, no HUD, no vehicles of war, no weapons, no real tactical information. Original composition; do not copy existing game art. All light, smoke and people are a static illustrated moment.

prompts.title: Crosswind Market Depot
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original Ukraine Atlas collectible reveal-background candidate, one full-bleed landscape 16:9 image, ideally 1536 x 864 pixels.
Primary request: A peaceful Ukrainian rail market and small heritage depot at dusk, rendered as rich modern pixel art. The rewarding scene connects careful preparation, shared supplies and the choice of a short crossing or a longer sheltered market route. This is fictional scenery, not a railway map or a gameplay screenshot.
Scene and cultural grounding: Invent a small Ukrainian station with modest brick and plaster architecture, timber platform awnings, a compact unbranded heritage steam locomotive parked quietly on a siding, warm depot workshop windows, a manual hand trolley, repair crates and a lively but orderly produce-and-craft market with woven baskets, apples, bread and plain earthenware. These broad rail motifs are informed by Ukrainian railway-operator museum and depot descriptions, not a replica of any station, locomotive serial or historic incident.
Composition: Elevated oblique panoramic view along a diagonal rail line into the distance. The platform supply alcove in the near foreground is a clear focal group; across the tracks a warm depot doorway provides a second focal point. A broad covered market lane curves around the left edge toward an open western gate, providing a distinct longer visual route. Sparse standing townspeople and a porter give human scale. Wind gently bends awnings and tree branches in a single static moment; rails and silhouettes remain readable. No operational railway instructions, signs or map overlay.
Style: Premium contemporary detailed pixel art, crisp stair-step contours, deliberate pixel clusters, restrained dithering and sophisticated materials. Deep navy and indigo evening shadows, honey/amber station lamps, dusty red brick, muted cream produce cloth. Rich details on baskets, tools, wheels and roofing; quiet dark-blue sky and corners, high focal clarity rather than uniform visual noise. Cozy historical atmosphere with no claim of exact period reconstruction.
Constraints: One original single scene, full rectangular landscape, no border, lettering, logos, signatures, UI, guns, combat, military cargo or recognizable copied game imagery. Avoid decorative folk-pattern mashups; this scene expresses working community and rail heritage through ordinary materials.

prompts.title: Carpathian Thread Relay
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original Ukraine Atlas collectible reveal-background candidate, one full-bleed landscape 16:9 image, ideally 1536 x 864 pixels.
Primary request: A beautiful peaceful Carpathian weaving workshop overlooking a misty mountain pass at first light, detailed modern pixel art with a visual connection between woven threads and a modest fictional civilian signal relay. Reward discovery of texture and the direct versus winding route, not combat.
Scene and cultural grounding: A fictional Ukrainian Hutsul workshop with hand-hewn timber, wooden handloom, thick natural sheep-wool yarn, restrained cream/charcoal/rust geometric lizhnyk blanket being woven, shuttles and yarn bundles. University field observations of handweaving in Yavoriv support these materials; invent all patterns and the unnamed artisan, do not copy any actual craftswoman's textile or attach symbolic meanings to invented motifs. Carpathian timber roofs and spruce slopes surround a secluded valley. The relay is a modest invented civilian communications/weather hut with a small antenna, not military equipment or a real installation.
Composition: Intimate loom and hands of a seated artisan in the left foreground, framing a very broad open window/porch view across the right two thirds. Wool threads in the foreground lead the eye toward a narrow footbridge crossing the misty ravine to the softly lit relay hut; a separate longer switchback path curls along the forested outer ridge. These are scenic parallels to route choices, not exact collision geometry or cable engineering. Layered mountain silhouettes and open pale mist create generous breathing space. A finished folded blanket and simple carved wood add rewarding close detail.
Style: Premium contemporary detailed pixel art with crisp stepped silhouettes, deliberate pixel clusters, restrained dithering, rich tactile wool and timber surfaces. Deep navy/teal mountain shadows, warm amber workshop lamplight and pale golden dawn rim, a few subdued rust textile accents. Quiet, humane, inviting atmosphere, readable large shapes with careful detail rather than continuous sparkle.
Constraints: Single original coherent full landscape, no borders, text, signatures, logos, HUD, pictorial arrows, weapons, military drone or real communications schematics. No copied game artwork or borrowed textile design. No generic mixing of Petrykivka, pysanka and Hutsul traditions; static original scenic interpretation, not certified historical reconstruction.
